I have some special artwork now available for a limited time.|Matilda Carson|<ref name="SWG:MC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Matilda Carson|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Matilda Carson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. She worked as a painting allocation engineer, handing out specific paintings to any and all who asked for them, including ''[[Intense Performer]]'', [[Imperial Agent (painting)|''Imperial Agent'']] and ''[[Padawan Training]]''.
